motions.item_title: Petition - Parkland Development Fees at 53 Woodside Road
motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That City Council, per Section 32(j) of Parkland Dedication By-law (2022) – 20717 as amended, exempts the project completed pursuant to Building Permit 24 0010280 000 2BRC from payment of parkland dedication cash-in-lieu in connection with the renovation of 53 Woodside Drive as specified therein. That City Council further directs City staff to issue a reimbursement to the property owners of the payments previously made in connection therewith.
motions.text_html:
1. That City Council, per Section 32(j) of Parkland Dedication By-law (2022) – 20717 as amended, exempts the project completed pursuant to Building Permit 24 0010280 000 2BRC from payment of parkland dedication cash-in-lieu in connection with the renovation of 53 Woodside Drive as specified therein.
  2. That City Council further directs City staff to issue a reimbursement to the property owners of the payments previously made in connection therewith.
